lines.text: Everyone, I need some help.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Tch.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Bwahahah!
?? What's going on?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Hehehe

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Anis and Rapi made a bet.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Since it's April Fools' Day,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: they bet whether you'd suddenly ask for help and bring up something weird.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Anis bet that you wouldn't say anything,

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: and Rapi bet that you would.
So that's what you think of me, Rapi?

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: I'd appreciate it if you thought of this as me having complete faith in you, albeit in a different sense.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Seriously, why do you keep trying to pull the same dumb trick every year?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I figured this year it'd be different.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: We should at least hear him out, since we're already talking.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: What can we help you with, Master? Haha

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: My guess is he discovered a giant robot.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I'll put my money on some crazy monster.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Then I'll go with... aliens!
This is so humiliating.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Well, Master, what's your answer?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Drumroll, please!

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: We're excited to hear what you have to say, Commander.
